name: resume-superstatus
description: getTasksToExecCommand_JEDI judges the T_TASK and superStatus update on the status a task lands in. A resume is carried out as the status 'dummy' (back to oldStatus), so the update, which tests for running, ready or scouting after paused, never fired on a resume, and a resumed task kept superStatus and DEFT status 'paused' until its next status change. Every other command is unchanged: its new status is not dummy.
